strategies.label: Single agent
strategies.description: One model call with the full toolset. The baseline every other row is measured against.

strategies.label: Plan then execute
strategies.description: A tool-less planning call, then a separate execution call that follows the plan.

strategies.label: Orchestrator with parallel workers
strategies.description: Decompose into subtasks, run workers concurrently, synthesise their reports.

strategies.label: Plan, execute, verify, revise
strategies.description: Adds a read-only verification pass that can send the work back for revision.

strategies.label: Parallel proposals, select, execute
strategies.description: Three read-only proposers, a selector, then one executor applies the winner.
